title: 26-Layer Random Initialization DBR with Unconstrained Thickness Exploration
scientific_hypothesis: Removing the monotonic chirp initialization constraint and allowing independent uniform random thickness initialization will enable the gradient optimizer to discover non-monotonic thickness profiles that better balance UV reflection and IR transmission, potentially improving tightest_margin while maintaining target score above 0.80.
design_principle: Multi-objective spectral optimization with randomized initialization allows escape from local minima imposed by structured chirp profiles. Evidence supports random thickness initialization for TMM optimization when quarter-wave designs are insufficient for broadband performance.
proposed_topology: 26-layer alternating stack: Air | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | Fused Silica
design_variables: initialization seed for random thickness generation
soft_objectives: Maximize mean reflectance in 300-450 nm band
Maximize mean transmittance in 1000-1700 nm band
manufacturing_considerations: Individual thickness bounds 30-250 nm for deposition feasibility
HfO2/SiO2 material pair compatible with electron beam evaporation
theory_basis: Transfer matrix method for planar multilayer interference
Random initialization avoids bias toward monotonic thickness profiles
expected_advantages: Optimizer can discover non-monotonic thickness patterns that chirp initialization suppresses
May improve tightest_margin by finding more robust local optima
Tests whether chirp constraint was limiting performance
known_risks: Random initialization may converge to lower-quality local minima
May require more optimization iterations than structured initialization
Could produce thickness profiles difficult to manufacture if extremes exceed bounds
execution_request_english: Design and optimize a 26-layer planar dielectric multilayer stack on fused silica substrate using alternating HfO2 and SiO2 layers under normal incidence plane-wave illumination. Initialize all 26 layer thicknesses independently using uniform random distribution bounded between 30 nm and 250 nm. Apply gradient-based thickness optimization to maximize mean reflectance in 300-450 nm band while maximizing mean transmittance in 1000-1700 nm band. Evaluate robustness under ±10% uniform thickness variation. Report best_target_score, tightest_margin, valid_candidates count, and optimized thicknesses_nm array for all candidates. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 300-450 nm, 1000-1700 nm. soft objectives: high transmission in 1000-1700 nm; high reflection in 300-450 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: reflection in 1000-1700 nm; transmission in 300-450 nm. manufacturing constraints: Maximum total layer count of 30.
revision_reason: Per feedback directive: explicitly remove monotonic chirp initialization constraint from iteration 17. Switch to independent uniform random thickness initialization to allow optimizer full exploration of thickness space. This tests whether chirp structure was constraining the optimizer from finding superior non-monotonic profiles.
